parameters.content:
## 1. Find the contact
Duplicate search by email, then by phone. A contact whose **Inquiry Source IDs** already holds this source id is a repeat: stop here, no AI call.

## 2. Classify
OpenAI (or a stored mock answer) sorts the lead. Code checks the enums and that the quote is really in the message. Any failure becomes **Needs review** with no draft and a Slack alert.

## 3. Write to GoHighLevel
Update the matched contact or create one (if GoHighLevel refuses it as a duplicate, update the contact it names). Add a note with the original message, then put the lead in the **Inquiries** pipeline: one open opportunity per contact, moved only upward, plus a follow-up task for Qualified.

## 4. Human review
Draft a reply, post the review link to Slack and wait. Nothing is sent until a named reviewer approves; the decision is saved as a note.
